name: Greymond. Saves the Specs
storyline:
Greymond is a ‘greylian’. He lives on the island of Greyland. His world, like the world of all greylians, is seen as shades of grey. One day, following flashes of unexplained colour, Greymond meets a wise, old greylian.

The wise, old greylian explains that Greyland used to bloom with all the colours of the spectrum – until the colours were stolen. He sets Greymond off on a quest to bring colour back to the island of Greyland.
summary:
Greymond is a flash game made by Grayscale with the assistance of the South Australian Film Corporation and the Australian Broadcasting Corporation.

The game is about a 'greylien', Greymond, who goes on a quest to bring colour back to the island of Greyland by saving seven 'specs', one for each colour of the rainbow. The gameplay and controls are different in each level, covering various genres.
